title: Unexpected Guest
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Nian's figure vanished into the night, the jade pendant suddenly quivered violently—a hoarse, unfamiliar voice echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record: "She's returned... The chess game is finally about to change."

text.content:
Midnight, deep within the Bamboo Grove at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the blue stone, fingertips caressing the jade pendant he had just obtained. Ancient runes flickered unsteadily under the moonlight, as if some long-dormant consciousness was awakening. And the agitation within the Tianji Record grew ever stronger, like a lurking beast catching the scent of its own kind.

He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly, and Mo Xiansheng's blurry soul outline trembled violently. "These runes..." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried terror for the first time, "They are the Chen family's bloodline mark!"

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open.

Outside the bamboo grove, faint footsteps approached—light as leaves brushing the ground. Had it not been for his honed vigilance over years, he would have been oblivious. He remained still, fingers discreetly moving to the storage pouch at his waist, securing the jade pendant.

A figure emerged from the bamboo shadows.

The visitor wore a faded cyan robe, his features refined, bearing a striking three-point resemblance to Chen Ji. His aura was so suppressed that Chen Ji could barely sense his presence—his cultivation was at least above Foundation Building Late Stage.

dialogue.content:
"Cousin Chen Ji, long time no see."

The man's voice was gentle, carrying an indefinable hint of amusement. He walked closer leisurely, as if this weren't a desolate mountain in the dead of night, but an ordinary stroll in his own backyard. Moonlight illuminated his face, revealing a pair of deep, almost cold eyes.

Chen Ji made no move to rise, merely gazing at the visitor.

"Elder cousin?" His lips curved slightly upward. "I don't recall any such figure in the Chen family."

His tone was flat, but his heart was churning beneath. He knew the Chen family's situation better than anyone—father dead early, mother remarried, the so-called clan members had severed all contact long ago. This self-proclaimed elder cousin could never be a real Chen.

text.content:
The man showed no anger, merely smiling lightly. "Of course you don't remember. You were only three then, and I... was sent very far away."

He stopped three zhang across from Chen Ji, moonlight stretching his shadow long. "My name is Chen Nian. Yes, just one character different from yours—because we are indeed blood relatives from the same lineage."

Chen Nian.

This name made Chen Ji's pupils contract. His missing sister—no, looking at her now, she hadn't appeared as a "younger sister" but under the guise of an "elder cousin". What did this mean? What had she experienced after being taken by the Holy Sect? Why had she changed her name, disguised her identity?

More importantly—how did she find him here?

dialogue.content:
"You're wondering how I knew you were at the Tianqing Sect?" Chen Nian seemed to read his thoughts. "Because I also possess something that can 'see'."

He raised his hand, sleeve falling back to reveal a pale wrist. Carved upon it was a rune—identical to the patterns on Chen Ji's jade pendant. "Chen family bloodline, passed down through a thousand years. Our bloodline was born to be... the nemesis of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content:
The nemesis of Heavenly Secrets.

Chen Ji finally understood why Chen Nian's presence could disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight—not because she herself was special, but because of the Chen family bloodline's unique trait. In ancient times, who had inscribed this ability into the Chen family's blood? And for what purpose?

His expression remained unchanged, but his mind raced through calculations. Chen Nian revealing herself willingly, showing her cards—this candor must conceal deeper schemes.

dialogue.content:
"Nemesis?" Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice carrying a hint of playfulness. "If you truly were my nemesis, you could have lurked in the shadows waiting for me to walk into my doom. Why come in the dead of night to reveal yourself?"

He rose, facing Chen Nian. Under the moonlight, their silhouettes overlapped. "Tell me—what do you want?"

text.content:
Chen Nian fell silent for a moment, her gaze falling on the jade pendant at Chen Ji's waist. "That thing in your hands... it shouldn't be in your possession."

"Oh?"

"The Tianji Record." Chen Nian's voice dropped very low. "And... the jade pendant our father left you before he died."

Father.

These two words struck Chen Ji's heart like a blunt knife, gouging into that scar he'd sealed away long ago. His fists unconsciously clenched tight, knuckles whitening. Twelve years—he never forgot that rainy night: father collapsed in a pool of blood, jade pendant clutched desperately in his grip, eyes filled with不甘 and despair.

"Do you know how our father died?" Chen Ji's voice was very light, almost devoid of emotion. But Chen Nian felt that suppressed chill—that killing intent forged through countless escapes from death and reversals in desperate situations.

"I know." Chen Nian didn't dodge. "Because... the one who killed him is related to me."

dialogue.content:
The air seemed to freeze.

Chen Nian raised her hand, stopping Chen Ji from potentially surging forward. "Listen to me. Our father wasn't killed by a single person—he died in a sacrifice. Holders of the Chen family bloodline, every generation becomes nourishment for the 'Eyes of Heavenly Way'. This is a fate we cannot escape."

"You're saying... father was killed by the Eyes of Heavenly Way?"

text.content:
"Not just father." Chen Nian's voice carried a hint of bitterness. "You and I, we're both on this chessboard."

He took a jade slip from his chest and tossed it to Chen Ji. "This contains the truth the Chen family has erased over a thousand years. Do you want to know what father saw before he died? Do you want to know why the Tianji Record chose you instead of me?"

Chen Ji took the jade slip but didn't examine it immediately. He stared into Chen Nian's eyes, word by word: "What do you want?"

dialogue.content:
"Cooperation."

Chen Nian spoke bluntly. "The Eyes of Heavenly Way have already noticed you. It won't be long before the first wave of reckoning arrives. I can help conceal the Tianji Record's aura, but before that—you need to become stronger. Strong enough to shake this chess game."

He paused, gaze complex. "We are blood-related siblings, yet in this chess game we've become opponents. Now... it's time to rewrite this."

choice.prompt: Can Chen Nian's words be trusted? Is this sudden "elder cousin" a long-lost family member, or an even more dangerous chess player?

choices.description: Pose a question only a real Chen family member could answer, to verify her identity
choices.visible_cost: May expose your own knowledge of her information
choices.risk_hint: If she can't answer, there must be something she's hiding; if she can, further judgment of her intentions is needed

dialogue.content: "Before our father died, was he holding that jade pendant with his left hand or right hand?"
Chen Nian fell silent for an instant. "His left hand. His left index finger had an old scar—from taking a blade for you when you were young."

choices.description: Agree to cooperate first, exchange for her intelligence and shelter, maintain independent judgment
choices.visible_reward: Obtain bloodline information and Heavenly Secrets concealment
choices.risk_hint: Cooperation means exposing more information, must be ready to turn hostile at any time

dialogue.content: "Cooperation is possible. But I have conditions—all intelligence must be shared, key decisions must pass through my approval."
Chen Nian smiled, this time a genuine smile. "Deal. Though... you're more like Father than I imagined."

choices.description: Not fully trusting, demanding she prove her sincerity first, hand over the core part of the bloodline secret
choices.risk_hint: If she has malicious intent, may prematurely expose your vigilance

dialogue.content: "Empty words anyone can say. If you want cooperation, show your sincerity first—hand over the core part of the 'bloodline secret' you mentioned."

Chen Nian's gaze tightened slightly, as if not expecting such caution from him. After a moment, he sighed. "Very well. Hidden within the Chen family bloodline is a switch—activating it can temporarily shield the Tianji Record's foresight. But the price is... it consumes the user's lifespan."

text.content:
Chen Nian did not urge, simply waiting quietly. Moonlight cast intersecting shadows across his face, making him appear both familiar and alien.

Night wind passed through the Bamboo Grove, rustling softly. Chen Ji lowered his eyes in contemplation, his fingers unconsciously rubbing the edge of the Jade Slip. This man claiming to be his brother had brought too much information—Chen family bloodline, the sacrifice to the Heavenly Eye, the truth behind Father's death...

Each piece alone was enough to overturn his existing understanding.

dialogue.content:
"I knew you wouldn't trust me easily." Chen Nian suddenly spoke, "But there is one thing you must know now—"

He raised his hand, drawing a rune in the Void. That rune resonated with the pattern on the Jade Pendant, causing the fragments of the Tianji Record to shudder violently.

"The Heavenly Eye has already sent its first pieces into the Tianqing Sect." Chen Nian's voice turned cold, "Ling Yuan... is not who you think he is."

text.content:
Ling Yuan.

The former Master of the Tianqing Sect, the supposed protector on the surface but secretly harboring malicious intent. Chen Ji had long suspected his true stance, but Chen Nian's words made him realize—matters were far more complex than imagined.

"Is he a piece of the Heavenly Eye? Or..." Chen Ji did not finish, but Chen Nian already understood his meaning.

"It's worse." A cold light flickered in Chen Nian's eyes, "He is there willingly."

Willingly becoming a piece of the Heavenly Dao. This meant Ling Yuan was not being controlled, but actively sold his soul to that transcendent consciousness. This realization was more chilling than simple betrayal—because volunteers are often more insane, more unscrupulous than the controlled.

"So your real purpose here is to warn me?" Chen Ji asked.

"More than that." Chen Nian shook his head, "I came to see if you have what it takes to become... the one who breaks the chess game."

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian turned around, his back to Chen Ji. In the moonlight, his silhouette appeared somewhat lonely.

"The year the Holy Sect took me, you were only five. They cultivated me into a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' specifically designed to deal with the holder of the Tianji Record." His voice was soft, "Ridiculous, right? Someone with Chen family bloodline, eventually becoming Heaven's tool against the Chens."

He turned his head back, looking at Chen Ji with a complex gaze. "I don't want to be a piece anymore. What about you?"

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer.

He simply stood there quietly, the Jade Pendant in his hand. Moonlight bathed the ground, stretching his shadow and Chen Nian's shadow long and close together.

At this moment, he suddenly remembered many things—Father's testament, Mother's tears, Master Mo's riddles, and the endless darkness deep within the Tianji Record.

He was never a saint. Holding grudges, not acting rashly, subverting expectations—these were the foundations of his survival in this world.

dialogue.content:
After a long while, Chen Ji spoke.

"You said you were cultivated by the Holy Sect into a Heavenly Fate Lock Key—then does Ling Yuan know about this? Does the Holy Sect know?"

Chen Nian was slightly stunned, then revealed a meaningful smile. "You really are like Father. At critical moments, you always think about intelligence and layout first."

"This is the instinct for survival." Chen Ji said coolly, "If you want cooperation, answer my question first."

text.content:
"Ling Yuan doesn't know." Chen Nian's smile faded, "But the Heavenly Eye... may have already sensed it."

He raised his hand to glance at the sky, the moon now obscured by thin clouds, the light in the Bamboo Grove suddenly dimming. "Time is running out. I need to stay by your side for a while, using my bloodline aura to mask the Tianji Record's fluctuations."

"And the price?" Chen Ji asked directly.

"The price..." Chen Nian paused momentarily, "Is my life."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted.

"Every concealment consumes my lifespan." Chen Nian's voice was very calm, as if discussing something trivial, "Approximately... three days each time. At my current cultivation level, I can only survive for three more years at most."

Three years.

This number echoed in Chen Ji's mind. In three years, this man claiming to be his brother would die. And he hadn't even had time to verify the truth of his words.

"Why?" Chen Ji asked the most critical question, "Why would you go this far?"

text.content:
Chen Nian turned around, revealing a genuine smile for the first time.

That smile held no calculation, no conspiracy, only an indescribable sense of relief and warmth.

"Because you are my brother."

His voice was soft, yet like a blunt knife, it cut fiercely into the scar tissue deep in Chen Ji's heart. "When Father died, I couldn't do anything. This time... I don't want to lose anyone else."

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Nian's sincere confession, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Drop your guard, accept this suddenly appearing brother, give each other a chance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a bloodline ally, activate hidden plot thread.
choices.risk_hint: Family ties may become a handle for exploitation in the future.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long time. Finally, he nodded lightly. "...Alright."

choices.description: Not fully believe, but not fully reject either, maintain observation.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment, not influenced by emotions.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may be disappointed because of this.

dialogue.content: "I will give you a chance to prove yourself." Chen Ji's voice returned to calm, "But before I confirm, keep your distance."

choices.description: Do not accept a life-for-life cooperation method, demand to find another way.
choices.visible_reward: Show the protagonist's bottom line, may trigger Mo Xiansheng's clue.
choices.risk_hint: The situation will be more dangerous in the short term.

dialogue.content: "Three years of lifespan in exchange for my safety?" Chen Ji sneered, "I don't need such charity. Tell me the secret of the bloodline, and I'll find my own way."

text.content:
The wind among the bamboo suddenly stopped.

Chen Nian was not angered by Chen Ji's attitude. Instead, he revealed a meaningful smile. "As expected, you won't accept easily. No matter, time will prove everything."

He took out a token from his sleeve and gently placed it on the blue stone. "This is the identity token of an Outer Disciple of the Holy Sect. With it, you can freely enter and exit the periphery of the Holy Sect. Inside are some things... you may want to know."

Chen Ji looked at the token but did not reach for it.

"Aren't you afraid I'll cause trouble at the Holy Sect with this token and bring you trouble?"

"Afraid?" Chen Nian chuckled lightly, "If you could really overturn the Holy Sect, I'd have to thank you instead."

He turned and walked deeper into the bamboo grove. Moonlight pierced through the clouds, falling on him once more, stretching his silhouette into something long and lonely.

Just as his figure was about to vanish into the bamboo shadows, he suddenly stopped.

"By the way, there's one more thing." Chen Nian did not turn around, yet his voice came through clearly, "Father left a message for you before he died. He asked me to tell you when you grew up—"

The night wind suddenly rose, stirring countless bamboo leaves to rustling.

"'At the end of Heavenly Secrets, all are merely chess pieces. But even the chess player... is not eternal.'"

dialogue.content:
The words fell, and Chen Nian's figure completely vanished into the night.

The bamboo grove returned to silence, with only the wind and insects. Chen Ji stood in place, holding the token and Jade Slip in his hands, his heart churning with indescribable emotions.

Bloodline, destiny, sacrifice, chess piece...

These words swirled in his mind, interweaving with the fragmented prophecies in the Tianji Record, gradually sketching out a vague picture.

What his father guarded with his life, the truth that the Eye of Heavenly Way coveted, the curse that had plagued the Chen family for a millennium—all the answers seemed hidden within this Jade Pendant and the fragmented Tianji Record.

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his fingertips tracing the runes on the Jade Pendant.

The agitation from the Tianji Record had calmed, but that feeling of being observed by some existence lingered. Chen Nian said the Eye of Heavenly Way had already noticed him—this was no idle threat. That transcendent consciousness, just how grand a chess game was it arranging?

He looked up at the night sky. The moon was completely obscured by clouds, and darkness surged in like a tide.

Tianqing Sect, Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect... the three great Sects vying for power, the Demonic Path's invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—the prelude to chaos had already begun, and he was destined to stand at the storm's center.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing down all the tangled thoughts.

No matter how much of what Chen Nian said was true, one thing was certain—he had no way back. The price of the Tianji Record, the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way, his father's遗愿... everything pushed him forward.

"Chess piece..." he murmured to himself, a cold smile suddenly curling at the corner of his lips, "Then let me see just how vast this chess game truly is."

He turned and walked toward the Tianqing Sect.

Behind him, a subtle tremor suddenly came from deep within the bamboo grove—the Jade Pendant that had been stored in the storage bag actually emitted a faint glow at this moment, as if responding to something. And deep within the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's faint soul silhouette slowly opened his eyes in the darkness.
